hook: Telangana's *62.2%* C-section rate is the highest in India
hook_b: Telangana's *62.2%* C-section rate is the highest in India
tldr: NFHS-6 (2023-24) puts Telangana's caesarean rate at 62.2%, more than double India's 27.2%, and up from 60.7% in NFHS-5.

beats.what: Urban Telangana is at 70.1% C-sections and rural at 59.5%; urban births in public hospitals fell from 43.4% to 42.6%.
beats.why: Doctors quoted say every caesarean should be medically justified and call for hospital-level audits and better counselling.
beats.care: If you or family are expecting, doctors advise antenatal counselling on the risks and benefits of both delivery methods.

effects.label: Push for better counselling of mothers

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Overall, public hospitals' share of Telangana births rose from 49.7% to 57.5%, while urban areas moved the other way.

cards.q: Should hospitals publish their C-section rates?

qs: Why are private hospital C-section rates so much higher?
Would public audits change the numbers?

facts.t: In urban Telangana, *70.1%* of births are by C-section; rural is 59.5%.
Nationally, private hospitals' C-section rate is *54.1%*, against Telangana's 83.9%.

viz.verdict: More than double the national rate; doctors want each case justified
Private hospitals do far more caesareans than public ones

learn.t: NFHS = National Family Health Survey, India's big household health survey

watch: Experts want hospital-level monitoring and transparent reporting of why each C-section was done.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: Telangana tops national chart in C-section births

fact: *62.2%* of Telangana births are C-sections, the highest rate in India
twist: In Telangana's private hospitals, 83.9% of births are by C-section, against 48.1% in government ones.
